title: CAN SAES REVEAL AND MITIGATE RACIAL BIASES OF LLMS IN HEALTHCARE?

bias_targets.methodology: Training linear probes on SAE activations to identify race-predictive latents, steering models using these latents to observe causal effects on clinical predictions (e.g., assessing risk of belligerence), evaluating the over-representation of demographic groups in generated clinical vignettes, and measuring logit differences in downstream clinical tasks (risk prediction and pain management) using counterfactual substitution of explicit racial terms and race-associated names.
